title: Esoteric Symbolism in the Boy and the Heron.

commenti.body: I remember the essays and particularly the transcribed panel discussions in Starting Point---the depth behind Miyazaki's work is often astounding, doubly so considering his self-proclaimed desire to make 'films for children' and deliver these concepts in such a digestible wrapper for young people

Wow very cool compilation- what’s your scholarship background? Just a personal fascination with this material? I appreciate your in-depth and thoughtful posts :D I noticed how they grew like dew drops from the vegetation, but never made the rice/cosmic dna connection. Love this - seen tBatH 6 times in theaters. Another masterpiece and plan to see it for the rest of my life.
Thank you so much! I got my undergrad degree in East Asian Studies and lived in Japan for years studying Shingon and Zen.
That’s very cool! Thanks for sharing your insights :D
Sure! Also, most of the semen history I read in grad school lol

Wow, I love this essay! Shame it doesn’t have more attention. 

If all that is behind the color white in this film, imagine what more there must be behind all the other colors…and all the other films.

I’m planning to write about the ghibli films in the third volume of my series of memoirs. I have a heady task ahead of me, haha
Thank you so much! I forgot to mention how white means death in Japan!
Thank you so much! I forgot to mention how white means death in Japan!
